Anya (PM): Quick heads-up 1 — post-launch triage for Reply Assist. Thinking a focused 2-week mini-patch: top 3 customer regressions + one UX polish. Keep it minimal and reversible.
Mike (Eng): Agree with narrow scope. Need perf baselines first  p99 on embed path spiked ~15% since launch.
Jorge (Support): Putting priority on rerank mismatch reports from 3 enterprise customers. I have repro queries and traces.
Lina (Design): UX polish = CTA copy + spacing tweak; small and low risk (~4h). Good optics for release notes.
Anya (PM): Proposed patch acceptance criteria:
- rerank regression fixed for customer repros
- rate-limiter behaves under bursts (no 429 storms)
- embed-path p99 brought down >=50% from current spike
- regression tests added + CI gate
- release notes + changelog entry
If all met, we release as a patch.
Mike (Eng): Can we realistically finish in 2 weeks? Current capacity ~= 1.5 engineers dedicated. I can take perf + rate-limiter. Need owner for rerank fix.
Jorge (Support): Support will attach repro artifacts and validate fixes. Recommend Alex owns rerank since it's model-adjacent.
Alex (ML Eng): I can pick rerank. Need exact customer queries, scoring traces, and matching configs. Jorge, can you attach payloads here?
Jorge (Support): Uploading case-1234 payloads and aggregated logs: <link to case-1234>. Also scheduling a short repro session with customer tomorrow 3pm.
Anya (PM): Constraint: no infra/schema churn in this patch. Minimal, revertible changes only. Rollout plan: canary 5% (2h) -> 25% (1h) -> full. Monitor p99, token errors, and rerank mismatch.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy command reminder: `/deploy patch --canary=5 --window=2h` after CI green.
Mike (Eng): My engineering checklist:
- [ ] Support repros attached
- [ ] Fix implemented
- [ ] Unit + regression tests added
- [ ] Perf runs vs baseline recorded
- [ ] Docs + release notes ready
- [ ] Canary rollout steps documented
Note: CI GPU tests flaky right now; if unresolved, may block cutoff. Filing CI ticket.
Lina (Design): I'll draft the release blurb and submit the tiny CSS/copy PR today.
Anya (PM): Owner map: Mike = perf & rate limiter; Alex = rerank; Jorge = customer repros/validation; Lina = release notes + UX; Anya = stakeholder comms & cutover decision. Branch cutoff: Thu EOD (48h).
Mike (Eng): Risk: CUDA GPU CI flakes could push timeline. I'll triage and escalate if needed.
Jorge (Support): I'll prioritize customer testcases into the ticket and coordinate live repro.
Alex (ML Eng): Starting rerank investigation once traces are in. If it's a model scoring config regression we may need a model-variant fallback for canary.
Anya (PM): If rerank fix looks larger than expected by tomorrow sync, we reduce scope to bug fixes only (drop UX). Quick sync tomorrow 11:00 to confirm scope and blockers. Everyone ok?
Mike (Eng): OK. Will post perf baseline numbers by EOD.
Alex (ML Eng): Got it. Will report progress in the thread.
Jorge (Support): Logs and repros posted in ticket.
Anya (PM): :thumbsup: Prioritize customer regressions. Minimal patch, measurable outcomes.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy monitoring playbook: check `metrics.p99_embed`, `errors.token_rate`, `rerank_mismatch_rate` for first 3 hours after full rollout.
